parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the activation code.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the activation code. Valid values:

*   activated
*   unactivated
*   expired

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc list-access-tokens --access-token-id at-bp1akz2zp67r0k6r0000 --name test_name --status activated --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc ListAccessTokens --region cn-hangzhou --Status activated --AccessTokenId.1 'at-bp1akz2zp67r0k6r0000' --Name test_name
